The '''Delantine system''' was a trinary [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that openly joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. It was conquered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Planets included [[Benon]], [[Delantine]] itself, [[Da'nor]], and [[Romm]].
